creatures.name: Lufani
creatures.voice: Very soft, airy trill rising in pitch, like a hummingbird fluttering and finishing with a bell-like chime.

creatures.name: Momo
creatures.voice: Quick, light fluttering purr with melodic chirps, reminiscent of a kitten purring and a swallow's warble.

creatures.name: Favasū
creatures.voice: Slow, breathy whoosh with trailing sighs, like a gentle night breeze stirring soft leaves.

creatures.name: Sīnali
creatures.voice: Sharp, wavering peep that crescendos to a high, trembling squeak, similar to a startled treefrog.

creatures.name: Nanave
creatures.voice: Long, drawn-out hum with a gentle downward pitch, similar to a contented sigh or distant owl's hoot.

creatures.name: Rālei
creatures.voice: High, sweet, warbling coo, bright and uplifting, like a morning dove greeting the dawn.

creatures.name: Puilu
creatures.voice: Fast, bubbly popping sounds interspersed with cheerful squeaks, like water droplets in a tiny spring.

creatures.name: Mirefa
creatures.voice: Rapid, twinkling chirrups with rolling vibrato, like two finches trading songs.

creatures.name: Sīnū
creatures.voice: Soft, misty taps growing fainter, resembling rainfall on thick leaves mid-dream.

creatures.name: Fanolū
creatures.voice: Tense, repeated trills escalating in pitch, ending with a shrill, vibrating buzz like a startled cicada.

creatures.name: Monoi
creatures.voice: Tender, very gentle high-pitch trill, as if softly twinkling windchimes in morning light.

creatures.name: Lumimi
creatures.voice: Rapid, crystal-clear peeps sprinkled with melodious whistle, reminiscent of a chorus of tiny birds.

creatures.name: Faneli
creatures.voice: Long, slow whoosh, fading gracefully, echoing the sound of silk ribbons whisked through the air.

creatures.name: Morra
creatures.translation: I sing joyful for the flower! (very happy)
creatures.voice: Exuberant, fast trill with a rolling 'rr' in the middle, like a rapturous songbird and monarch butterfly wingbeats.

creatures.name: Mimisi
creatures.translation: Play with many friends and flower! (happy)
creatures.voice: Chattering, staccato series of high chirps like a cluster of fluffy chicks celebrating.

creatures.name: Sīfafa
creatures.voice: Stuttering, wet, sharp notes, as if a shower spins on butterfly wings; a touch of urgency like a shaken bell.
